Ads reports: what campaigns, ad groups and ads spent and earned, which creatives work, and how
cohorts pay back. Days are cut in the ad accounts' time zone unless --timezone says otherwise.

Usage:
  voidhash ads report <command> [flags]

Commands:
  performance  What each campaign, ad group or ad spent and got.
  creatives    Which creatives spend the most, what they earn, and which show fatigue.
  cohorts      Payback by acquisition cohort.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash ads report <command> --help' for more about a command.
